headline: Nifty Eyes Resistance at 23,200 as Indian Markets Look to Extend Gains Ahead of Diwali

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty reclaimed 23,000 with Sensex gaining over 300 points in the previous session.
Bulls are looking to extend market gains in the lead-up to Diwali.
Wall Street history and S&P 500 returns offer broader cues for D-Street action.
Coal India reported a 19% jump in production following recovery from monsoon slumps.
whatHappening: Traders are eyeing resistance around 23,200 for Nifty as trading resumes.
Affle 3i announced a $420 million all-cash deal to acquire Israel's Perion Network.
Coal India recorded a 19% production boost as mining operations recovered.
Power utilities in Southern Odisha and Andhra Pradesh are on high alert due to Cyclone Murasu.
summary: Indian benchmark indices show signs of recovery ahead of Diwali after Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level. Major corporate developments include Affle's $420 million acquisition of Perion Network and Coal India's 19% output rebound. Market participants are watching 23,200 resistance levels on Nifty for directional cues.
